test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man, a woman and a boy can complete a job in 3, 5 and 15 days, respectively. How many boys must assist 1 man and 1 woman to complete the job in (1)/(5) of a day?
solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

Man's 1-day work = 1/3

Woman's 1-day work = 1/5

Boy's 1-day work = 1/15

According to the question-

⇒ 1 × (1/3) + 1 × (1/5) + x × (1/15) = 1/(1/5)

{ ∵ x be the no. of boys needed}

⇒ x/15 = 5 - (1/3) - (1/5)

⇒ x/15 = (75 - 5 - 3)/15

⇒ x = 67 

**∴__ 67__ Boys are needed to complete the work.**
